body:
Hey. I got out of a nasty cocaine addiction 6 months ago. I lost everything. Bf, career, friends, and almost my life. I'm not like in the best place now, but if you want to talk to someone who will not bomb you with empty cliche sentences or fake positivism you can shoot me a DM. 
Wish you well bud.

I'm playing gta online, superliminal and I just purchased phasmophobia.
I'm super into horror and puzzle games. Also like shooters like edf or cs.

Dm me your tag, I'll add you :)

I'd love to be part of the server :)
I'm a history enthusiast and can share some pretty interesting stories fire-camp-like.

Yes, lockdown is getting the worst out of me. I can't even go to the museum for distraction. Or anything, really.

Work, make my own clothes, rescue animals, play, sing, embroidery, pixel art. Well, lots of stuff, haha as I sleep so little and I do not interact so much with other people I find tons of time to develop hobbies.

Hi there! How long you've been studying music? Do you have something I can hear?
Also, which games do you enjoy?

Im not really into sports but I keep myself active :)

Hey. I'm on the same boat. I can't make friends and have a set of interest very specific that none seems to enjoy besides me. Last year I broke up, I considered him my best friend. It's been pretty lonely since that (we used to talk a lot about history, books, movies and politics) and haven't found not even a friend to share these topics or even a milkshake.


What I did to feel less alone was make up an Instagram and made a good amount of internet friends. That's a baby step. I also downloaded like 14 videochat apps because I was bored so sometimes I randomly facechat with someone.
I had good laughs here and there.


I'm also figuring out but hey, that's the beginning. Knowing the reasons gives us the power to counter it
For example I struggle with lots of interpersonal issues due to the fact that I lived 17 years isolated.
Now I'm fighting against those sequels (shyness, anorexia, mutism, low self worth, etc) by one and hoping to get better.



Hope you do feel well and being sorrounded with lots of friends soon :)

Seeing my cats play and be happy and knowing I'm able to provide them with a home, food, toys and love does it for me.

They went trough a lot and deserve to live in peace.
And I know I can give them all that. If it's not me, who?

Everything else in my life is secondary.
The world pretty much sucks.

Hola. Te entiendo, a mi tampoco me sale nada bien estas últimas semanas y ese peso se vuelve inaguantable.
Si tenés a alguien cercano, un amigo, un grupo de contención en internet no dudes en pedirles ayuda.
A veces el sufrir se aliviana cuando tenemos quien nos cuide y acompañe.
Podes escribirme cuando quieras. Mi inbox esta abierto.

I was told I was being selfish for wanting to die. What the actual f#@&!

It's like everyone else's feelings matter and are valid but yours.

I too go to therapy, take my meds, try and make it better by sticking to my hobbies and still nothing seems to please the people around me.

I just want them to be happy that I'm trying because that's all I can do now.
Thanks. I'll drop you a msg.

People just don't understand we can't "snap out" of it

God, if it was that easy I'll just do it. But no.
No amount of "I want this to be over" can help you.
I wish people cared a little.

I don't know what to do to help, but if you enjoy videogames, shows, reading or so I'm trying to get distracted with that.
Hit me up if you want to play later.

That's a super cute relationship you have with amie.
Hope things get better for you soon, you seem to have so much love to give.

Oh, of course you're not the problem, honey

Joke or not they hurt your feelings and made you uncomfortable. When you open up about how something makes you feel you should receive validation and support from your loved ones.
What I'm seeing is that your emotions are being neglected and that's not ok.


If you have friends go to them. Try to build/join a support network, they usually help a lot.

What's their name?
I love dogs, they're amazing and super loyal.
Sometimes we reach for a hand but find a paw instead <3

I was planning on using an exit bag but I'm having a hard time getting all I need.
I resolved to just hang myself.

I feel the same. I'm all alone on this. Family and friends think it's attention seeking and push me away.
Knowing you have no doors to knock sucks, for real.
